bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
name=gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' "$name" 2>/dev/null)" = true || exit 61
url="$(docker exec "$name" sh -c 'printf %s "$VIDEOBOT_SHOP_PUBLIC_URL"')"
test -n "$url" || exit 81
case "$url" in https://*.g-acebot.com) ;; *) exit 82;; esac
docker exec "$name" node -e 'fetch("http://127.0.0.1:8766/health").then(r=>process.exit(r.ok?0:1)).catch(()=>process.exit(1))' || exit 83
docker logs --tail 160 "$name" 2>&1 | grep -q '^STICKER_SHOP_HTTP_READY=PASS$' || exit 84
echo STK_SHOP_LOCAL_READY=PASS
